correctness.rationale: At order three on three labeled symbols, nine nonpalindromic reversal pairs bound any orientable cyclic word by nine windows. Every extremal cyclic word chooses one directed edge from each of nine pairs, and Euler balance/strong connectivity characterize its admissibility. The actual verify_euler.py enumerates all 512 choices, ten balanced masks, two connected masks; the matrix-tree/BEST calculation gives four cyclic Euler circuits for each. Independent direct enumeration of all 3^9 rooted words gives exactly eight rotation classes; all six symbol permutations plus reversal split them into orbit sizes 6 and 2. The reported eight canonical words were reobtained independently. No extrapolation to higher orders is used.

evidence: The broader-period construction and bounds concern attainable length, not complete classification of all period-nine maximizers.
broader_coverage.reasoning: No inspected broader parameter theorem gives an extremizer population or orbit refinement; constructions are strictly weaker information.
